name: lambda-deprecated-runtime-transform-remediation-planner
description: Starts from the Trusted Advisor Lambda deprecated-runtime check, classifies each flagged function against the deprecation phases with block-deploy deadlines, and plans the code upgrade through AWS Transform (assessment, transformation, verification) with human approval gates and a per-function rollback. Read-only and plan-only: a human starts each Transform job, approves each code change, and approves each deploy. Complements the runtime tracker (165) and the deadline/roadmap planner (265) by orchestrating the Transform-driven, TA-sourced remediation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on TUE at 08:00 UTC
